$\Delta_\text{enc}={L_\text{full}}-{L_\text{frozen}}$ per seed, in percent of the cell's
zero-shot reference, so a positive value means allowing the encoder to adapt made the cell
\emph{worse}.  B and D share a seed, an initialisation and a window sample, so this
contrast is paired by construction.
$d$ is paired Cohen's $d$; dispersion is SEM, matching the body convention
(\S\ref{sec:method}) and not the population std the stored JSON fields use.
Each row names its own $n$, which is not constant down the column
(Table~\ref{tab:heldout_all}).
\textbf{Two tests, because neither alone is adequate at these seed counts.}
$p_\text{exact}$ enumerates all $2^N$ sign assignments, so it assumes nothing---but its
resolution is fixed by $N$: the smallest two-sided value an $N$-seed cell can produce is
$2/2^N$, which is $0.25$ at $N{=}3$ and $0.0625$ at $N{=}5$.  The 24 cells at
$N{=}3$ therefore \emph{cannot} reach $p<0.05$ however large or consistent their
effect, and a non-significant exact $p$ on those cells is a statement about seed budget
rather than about the effect.  The CI and $p_t$ are the paired $t$ versions, which do
resolve at $N{=}3$ and pay for it with a normality assumption on three points that cannot
be checked.  Where the two agree the reading does not rest on that assumption; where they
disagree, the evidence is assumption-dependent and is treated as such in the text.
We do \emph{not} report a percentile bootstrap interval here: every resample mean lies
within the range of the observations, so at $N{=}3$ with all seeds on one side of zero such
an interval excludes zero by construction, restating the sign count it was meant to improve
on.  It is kept in \texttt{results/paired\_inference.json} for the larger cells.
In the two summary rows the last column is \emph{not} an effect size: it gives the number
of cells whose mean $\Delta_\text{enc}$ is positive, out of the cells in that row.
$\dagger$ marks cells clearing the gate threshold under at least one admissible baseline
of the ladder (Appendix~\ref{app:baselines}).
$\ddagger$ marks the Chronos cells, whose per-condition forgetting is confounded by the
head/decoder mismatch; their $\Delta_\text{enc}$ is unaffected.}
